1. RemindHer: best for the family mental load

RemindHer is a shared family calendar and task app built around the invisible work of remembering everything for everyone. You can add tasks by voice, and they are shared with your partner or co-parent so the list is not only in your head.

It also connects with Google Calendar, so family events can sit next to your own. Disclosure: RemindHer is made by the founder of FOCO, the app that publishes this site.
It depends on the problem. RemindHer suits the shared family list, FOCO suits starting one task, and TimeTree or Cozi suit the household calendar.
